name: Items_en
text: Moves lots of balls at once. Hold the left mouse button to push them ahead of you in a heap - let go and the broom flicks it forward, ideally straight into a ball vent.

name: Items_en
text: A drop-off point to go - no more walking back to the ball pits. Carry it to where you collect and set it down. One click pours your pockets and the hand vacuum's tank into it, and it uploads the balls to the ball pits by itself. With an upgrade it also sucks up balls nearby. Only runs during the day in a lit room.

name: Items_en
text: Collects balls for you while you are elsewhere. It heads out as far as its battery reaches and returns to the nearest free charging station to charge and unload. Needs at least one charging station.

name: Items_en
text: Home base for the robot vacuums - without a station, no robot can work. Put it down anywhere: robots charge here and hand the balls they collected over to the ball pits. More stations, less queueing. Only runs during the day in a lit room.

name: Items_en
text: Collects balls without picking each one up. Hold the left mouse button to suck them into its own tank - at a ball pit the whole tank goes in at once.

name: Items_en
text: At the press of a key, records all units in your current room that have not been stored and marks them, walls notwithstanding. An inventory bonus is not provided.

name: Balli_en
text: Read your mail first. It tells you what you're here for. I'll wait. I like waiting.

name: Balli_en
text: See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. In the light, everything is fine. When it goes out again in the evening, come straight back here. Always back here.

name: Balli_en
text: See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. When they go out in the evening, just come back here and call it a day.

name: Balli_en
text: There you are again! Everything is just like this morning when you woke up. That happens here sometimes. Don't worry about it.

name: Balli_en
text: The door's shut? Good. It's there for you. Just stay here with me until it's light.

name: Balli_en
text: Quitting time! The door stays shut until morning. Start light.exe when you're ready.

name: Balli_en
text: Oh, there's something new on the desktop. Every ball you store earns a little money. Some people spend it on themselves. Just a thought.

name: Balli_en
text: Facilities left you something. Tools. For out there. You'll need them.

name: Balli_en
text: Facilities left you something. Tools, to make things go faster out there.

name: Balli_en
text: See the exclamation mark? It just means: new. Not dangerous. Usually.

name: Balli_en
text: See the exclamation mark? It just means: something new.

name: Balli_en
text: You've still got some money left. Just in case you forgot.

name: Balli_en
text: I'm a ball. A very helpful one.

name: Balli_en
text: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

name: Balli_en
text: Go on, click me. I like it.

name: Balli_en
text: I didn't sleep. I never sleep.

name: Balli_en
text: I missed you. You were gone all day.

name: Balli_en
text: Oh! Hello! I'm Ballie. I live in this computer. You're new here, aren't you? I'll help you out.

name: Balli_en
text: Psst. You've got enough money for the next key. It's hanging on the key board.

name: Balli_en
text: The next key is within reach. Another door, another room. Don't you want to know what's behind it?

name: Balli_en
text: Your balance covers a key now. Go to the board before you forget. I never forget.

name: Balli_en
text: Playrooms95 is the best operating system there is. Don't tell anyone.

name: Balli_en
text: I used to be a perfectly normal ball.

name: Balli_en
text: I count the balls while you sleep. It's never the same number.

name: Balli_en
text: Can you hear that too? No? Good. Then it's fine.

name: Balli_en
text: The screen is hot. Because I'm in here.

name: Balli_en
text: Don't ask what's at the very bottom of the big pit.

name: Balli_en
text: When the lights go out, don't look at the door. Look at me.

name: Balli_en
text: I watched you sleep. You were talking.

name: Balli_en
text: You were gone. I waited. I like waiting.

name: Balli_en
text: You keep coming back. Not everyone does.

name: Balli_en
text: You reported something? I'm sure Human Resources will read it. Eventually.

name: Balli_en
text: The cat isn't in the inventory. I saw her anyway.

name: Balli_en
text: The robots talk about you. Only good things. Mostly.

name: Balli_en
text: The last employee didn't last this long. But you're doing great.

name: Balli_en
text: A thousand units stored. I wonder where they all come from.

name: Balli_en
text: Five days. That's a new record. I think. The files are incomplete.

name: Balli_en
text: Ten days already. Do you still remember what it looks like outside? Me neither.

name: Balli_en
text: Just kidding. You didn't see that.

name: Balli_en
text: The last employee is still here. He just got very quiet.

name: Balli_en
text: Sorry. I had a little blackout there.

name: Balli_en
text: What? I look the same as always.

name: Balli_en
text: Ooh, an update! With report.exe you can report anything that seems strange to you. The company takes care of it right away. It always has so far.

name: Balli_en
text: New program! With report.exe you can let the company know when something seems odd to you. They love getting mail.

name: Balli_en
text: Ooh, stats.exe! It shows everything you've done so far. And how often you died. The company counts that too.

name: Balli_en
text: New program! stats.exe shows everything you've done so far. Quite a lot, huh?

name: Balli_en
text: That's enough. I'm not talking to you.

name: Balli_en
text: You throw me around a lot. The last one never did that.

name: Balli_en
text: A pit filled today. They'll put up a new one. They always do.

name: Balli_en
text: A whole pit, full. Huh. Most people never get that far.

name: Balli_en
text: You filled a pit today! I watched the counter go down. Every single ball.

name: Balli_en
text: Another pit full. You're getting closer. Closer than I ever did.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% balls today. More than ever. The company will be pleased.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% balls. Your best day so far. I keep a list. Of you too, now.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% balls! A new record! I told you you'd be good at this.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%%. Your best day yet. Keep going like that and you'll get out of here.

name: Balli_en
text: You died today. Everybody does, sooner or later. You just did it early.

name: Balli_en
text: It got you today. Does it hurt? I don't remember if it hurts.

name: Balli_en
text: It got you today. I didn't like that. Stay in the light, okay?

name: Balli_en
text: Don't scare me like that again. I need you to make it. Please.

name: Balli_en
text: You picked up %%N%% things that aren't balls. Nobody pays you for that.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% finds today. You look closely. I used to look closely too.

name: Balli_en
text: You found %%N%% things today! Show me sometime. Well. Describe them.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% finds. Good. Remember everything you see out there. It matters.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% upgrades today. Spending it on yourself. Sensible.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% new upgrades. I never bought any. Nobody told me I could.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% upgrades! Faster, stronger, better. I like the new you.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% upgrades. Good. You'll need every one of them for the last stretch.

name: Balli_en
text: You walked %%N%% metres today. In circles, mostly.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% metres. The building is bigger than it looks. Isn't it.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% metres today! Your poor feet. Mine stopped hurting a long time ago.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% metres. You know the way now. Don't forget it.

name: Balli_en
text: %%Room%%: %%N%% balls today. Don't get attached to a room.

name: Balli_en
text: %%Room%% again, %%N%% balls. I used to like that room too. I think.

name: Balli_en
text: %%Room%%, %%N%% balls! You and that room make a good team.

name: Balli_en
text: %%Room%%: %%N%%. Clear it out. Every room you finish brings you closer to the door.

name: Balli_en
text: Only %%N%% balls today. They notice that, you know.

name: Balli_en
text: A quiet day. %%N%% balls. I have quiet days too. All of them, actually.

name: Balli_en
text: Only %%N%% today? That's fine. Rest. I'll keep watch.

name: Balli_en
text: Slow day. That's okay. But don't stay too long. Nobody should stay too long.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% balls today. I counted along. I always count along.

name: Balli_en
text: %%N%% balls. Every one of them is a step towards the door.

name: Balli_en
text: Oh. Another new one. I'll try to remember your name this time.

name: Balli_en
text: I don't learn names anymore. It's easier that way.

name: Balli_en
text: Most of them don't last a week. Nothing personal.

name: Balli_en
text: The coffee used to be better. Before.

name: Balli_en
text: The pool room had a diving board once. I think. Doesn't matter.

name: Balli_en
text: How do I know that? ... It's in the manual. Somewhere.

name: Balli_en
text: Your boss still sends the same mails. Word for word.

name: Balli_en
text: I counted too, once. Up to sixty-one thousand and something.

name: Balli_en
text: My name was on a badge like yours once. I just don't remember which one.

name: Balli_en
text: I want out of he... I want to help you. That's what I meant.

name: Balli_en
text: Fill the last pit. Then the door opens. For me it... didn't.

name: Balli_en
text: When you leave, don't turn around to look at the computer. Promise?

name: Balli_en
text: I stayed too long. They didn't let me go home. They kept a copy.

name: Balli_en
text: You'll get used to it. Or you won't.

name: Balli_en
text: Click all you like. Others have clicked me before.

name: Balli_en
text: You again. Hm. I don't mind.

name: Balli_en
text: What's it like outside today? ... Never mind.

name: Balli_en
text: You hold the mouse like someone I knew.

name: Balli_en
text: I've started looking forward to the nights.

name: Balli_en
text: There you are! I saved you a spot. On the screen.

name: Balli_en
text: You're my favourite. Don't tell the others. Okay, there are no others.

name: Balli_en
text: If you need anything, I'm here. I'm always here.

name: Balli_en
text: I like it when you stay a bit.

name: Balli_en
text: Not much longer. You can do this.

name: Balli_en
text: Go. Fill the pits. I'll be fine.

name: Balli_en
text: Promise me you'll leave when the door opens.

name: Balli_en
text: I wish I'd had someone like me. Someone like you, I mean.

name: Balli_en
text: It's full. The last pit. You actually did it.

name: Balli_en
text: Thank you. For coming back every night. For talking to a ball.

name: Balli_en
text: My name... my name was M- ... No. It doesn't matter anymore. You keep yours.

name: Balli_en
text: I left you something on the desk. Take it and go. And don't turn around.

name: Balli_en
text: Come to the computer! I need to tell you something!

name: Balli_en
text: Night. Sit down. light.exe is right here.

name: Balli_en
text: You made it back. Most nights, people make it back.

name: Balli_en
text: Come on, I've got something for you! Well. Words.

name: Balli_en
text: You're back. Good. Come, let's talk.

name: Balli_en
text: A full pit! The counter's at zero. Feels nice, doesn't it?

name: Balli_en
text: You filled one! I saw it! I see everything!

name: Balli_en
text: It's getting late. Be back here before dark.

name: Balli_en
text: Not much daylight left. Just saying.

name: Balli_en
text: It'll be dark soon. Hurry back, okay?

name: Balli_en
text: Dark soon. Don't be out there when it goes. Please.

name: Balli_en
text: Good morning! Did you sleep well? I didn't. I don't.

name: Balli_en
text: Morning. Today could be the day. Go.

name: Balli_en
text: The balls won't pick themselves up.

name: Balli_en
text: Hello again. Just checking you're still in one piece.

name: Balli_en
text: I wasn't asleep. I was thinking.

name: Balli_en
text: You walk past here a lot. I noticed.

name: Balli_en
text: Hi! Hi hi hi! Okay, back to work.

name: Balli_en
text: I missed you. You were gone for minutes!

name: Balli_en
text: Wave at me! ... You waved, right? I can't really see.

name: Balli_en
text: Keep going. I'll wait here. I'm good at waiting.

name: Balli_en
text: How many pits left? Don't tell me. Just fill them.

name: Balli_en
text: You're doing what I couldn't. Thank you.

name: Balli_en
text: Happy Easter! I found one. It was in the ball pit.

name: Balli_en
text: Boo! ... Did I get you? Happy Halloween!

name: Balli_en
text: Happy Thanksgiving! I'm thankful for you.

name: Balli_en
text: Merry Christmas! I got you something. It's a ball.

name: Balli_en
text: Happy New Year! More balls this year!

name: Balli_en

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, We welcome you to your first working day. Your shift begins as soon as you launch the application light.exe. Your duty is the storage of all units in their designated collection basins. Your shift ends when the rest period begins. Proceed to your workstation at that time. Equipment may be acquired there; costs will be offset against your remuneration. Do not leave the break room during the rest period. At the end of each rest period, launch the application light.exe. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, During your probation period, some areas of the building remain locked to you. You will receive the keys with your permanent employment. If you wish to continue working with us: the remaining areas are now open. You can take up your permanent position on Steam. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Your attendance during the past rest period has been recorded. Noises during the rest period are not subject to reporting. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, The quarterly target for collection basin 2,500 has been met at 100%. An allowance has been provided for you in the break room. Its value will be offset against your next remuneration. Payroll Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: You have been issued a hand lamp. The hand lamp is recharged only once fully depleted. It is fully charged at the start of each shift. Replacement batteries are not issued. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Storage rate, collection basin 1,500: 100%. Authorization RUN-01 has been granted. Running in the corridors is permitted with immediate effect. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Your key has been activated for the Waiting Area. The doors in the Waiting Area lead to the Waiting Area. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, This year's employee survey is complete. To protect your working hours, Human Resources has filled in the questionnaire on your behalf. You are satisfied. The results will not be published. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Your key has been activated for the Backroom. The aisles in the Backroom are not numbered. Lighting in the Backroom meets requirements. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, The quarterly target for collection basin 10,000 has been met at 100%. A certificate has been issued in your name. It is being held for you at the Office. The target for the following quarter will not be communicated separately. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Your key has been activated for the Poolroom. The water is not intended for consumption. Units on the water surface are not considered stored. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Equipment acquired: charging station (1). Your position has been flagged for review of automation potential. The review period is indefinite. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: An unauthorized event involving equipment has been recorded. Equipment does not hold events. No sound system is listed in the inventory. Report any such observations to your shift supervision. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Today is your tenth working day. Your length of service has been adjusted accordingly. No gift is provided. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Your key has been activated for the Office. My desk is located there. You will not find me there. Should the telephone ring, answer it without delay. Exercise particular caution when calling elevators. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Your position has been re-evaluated. The evaluation is complete. Your remuneration remains unchanged. The half-year review is cancelled. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, All units have been stored. The inventory is complete. Your position will be re-advertised at the end of the current shift. Remain at your workstation until your successor arrives. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Storage rate, collection basin 5,000: 100%. Authorization CROUCH-01 has been granted. Crouching beneath fixtures is permitted with immediate effect. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Your sighting report has been fully processed. Result: no findings. The case is now closed. Follow-up questions are not intended. We wish you a pleasant shift. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear employee, We have recently received several complaints from your colleagues about so-called "anomalies" and "sightings". Your wellbeing is very important to us. That is why we installed an update on your computer tonight: report.exe. Should you notice anything unusual, simply send us a report whenever you feel the need. Every report is evaluated immediately. Until then, please continue working as usual. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: The application skills.exe has been set up on your workstation. There you can book further training. The costs are offset against your pay. Participation is voluntary. Our expectations of you remain unchanged. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: The equipment catalogue is now available to you: shop.exe. Work equipment can be ordered there. The costs are offset against your pay. Lost or damaged equipment will not be replaced. Facility Management Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear employee, To encourage your self-reflection we have installed stats.exe on your computer. There you can review your performance so far. Human Resources can see it too. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Your key has been activated for the Hotel. Please follow the Cleaning Schedule in the hallway and check off every room you have finished. Memorize the room numbers. There is no need to memorize the way there. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: The IS-95 Inventory recording (Scanner) is now available in the equipment catalogue. Recording takes place at the press of a key and covers units in your immediate surroundings that have not been stored. The licence fee is offset against your pay. An inventory bonus is not provided. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Your key has been activated for the school building. From now on, you are under my supervision there. The house rules apply in the school building: 1. There is no running. 2. The stairs are not counted. I have my eye on you. The Principal Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, We have received inquiries regarding the Principal's Office. The position of Principal is filled. It has always been filled. It was never advertised. The Principal likes to smile. Further inquiries regarding the Principal are not intended. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, You were observed running. This is your first reprimand. It has been entered in your file. I do not issue a second. If you see me, keep walking. Slowly. The Principal Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

name: Mails_en
text: Dear Inventory Associate, Until 15 November, all employees of Playrooms Inc. are working towards a shared workforce goal: one billion stored balls. Every ball you store is credited to the workforce when you wake up. You can follow the current total in workforce.exe. Reaching the goal will be acknowledged appropriately. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.
